about.title: From Kamojang Crater to D'Glorious Crater
about.historyLead: Kamojang Crater has been known since colonial times as one of the oldest geothermal fields in Indonesia.
about.historyBody: Steam from the cracks in the rock and the smell of sulfur have long been part of daily life here. To people nearby the crater is not just a natural feature. There are stories passed down about the power of the earth, and there is hot spring water that keeps you warm.
about.historyBody2: This geothermal conservation area has drawn researchers and travellers for years. In 2023 D’Glorious Crater Kamojang began operating here, reworking access to the crater, the hot pools, and the places to stay without changing the character of the site.
about.historyBody3: Mornings here are almost always foggy. Through the afternoon people gather at the hot pools, and once the sun drops the temperature follows it into the teens. Guests who stay the night usually spend it outside the tent rather than in it.
about.historyBody4: What we protect is simple: the crater and the forest around it should not be worse off for our being here. Parts of the site are deliberately left alone, and the number of tents is capped so this slope does not turn into a car park.
about.ticketNote: Prices can change. Message us on WhatsApp to confirm current rates.
